part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: PART I HOW THESEUS LIFTED THE STONE

translation.en: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
translation.kr: [1부: 테세우스가 바위를 들어 올리다]

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: Once upon a time there was a princess in Trœzene, Aithra, the daughter of Pittheus the king.  She had one fair son, named Theseus, the bravest lad in all the land; and Aithra never smiled but when she looked at him, for her husband had forgotten her, and lived far away.  And she used to go up to the mountain above Troezene, to the temple of Poseidon and sit there all day looking out across the bay, over Methana, to the purple peaks of Ægina and the Attic shore beyond.  And when Theseus was full fifteen years old she took him up with her to the temple, and into the thickets of the grove which grew in the temple-yard.  And she led him to a tall plane-tree, beneath whose shade grew arbutus, and lentisk, and purple heather-bushes.  And there she sighed, and said, ‘Theseus, my son, go into that thicket and you will find at the plane-tree foot a great flat stone; lift it, and bring me what lies underneath.’

translation.en: Once, Princess Aithra lived in Troezen.
translation.kr: 옛날 트로이젠에 아이트라라는 공주가 살았습니다.

translation.en: She was the daughter of King Pittheus.
translation.kr: 그녀는 피테우스 왕의 딸이었습니다.

translation.en: She had a brave son named Theseus.
translation.kr: 그녀에게는 온 나라에서 가장 용감한 테세우스라는 아들이 있었습니다.

translation.en: Aithra only smiled when she looked at him.
translation.kr: 아이트라는 아들을 볼 때만 미소를 지었습니다.

translation.en: Her husband had left her to live far away.
translation.kr: 그녀의 남편이 그녀를 잊은 채 멀리 떠나 살았기 때문입니다.

translation.en: She often went up the mountain to the temple of Poseidon.
translation.kr: 그녀는 종종 트로이젠 위의 산에 있는 포세이돈 신전에 올라갔습니다.

translation.en: She would sit there all day.
translation.kr: 그녀는 하루 종일 그곳에 앉아 있었습니다.

translation.en: She looked across the bay past Methana.
translation.kr: 그녀는 바다를 지나 메타나 너머를 바라보았습니다.

translation.en: She watched the purple peaks of Aegina and the distant Attic shore.
translation.kr: 그녀는 아이기나의 자줏빛 봉우리와 저 멀리 아티카 해안을 지켜보았습니다.

translation.en: When Theseus turned fifteen, she took him to the temple.
translation.kr: 테세우스가 열다섯 살이 되자, 그녀는 아들을 신전으로 데려갔습니다.

translation.en: They walked into the thick grove in the temple yard.
translation.kr: 그들은 신전 뜰에 있는 울창한 숲으로 들어갔습니다.

translation.en: She led him to a tall plane tree.
translation.kr: 그녀는 아들을 키가 큰 플라타너스 나무로 이끌었습니다.

translation.en: Bushes and purple heather grew in its shade.
translation.kr: 그 그늘 아래에는 덤불과 자줏빛 히스가 자라고 있었습니다.

translation.en: She sighed and spoke to him.
translation.kr: 그녀는 한숨을 쉬며 아들에게 말했습니다.

translation.en: Theseus, my son, go into that thicket.
translation.kr: 테세우스야, 저 덤불 속으로 들어가거라.

translation.en: You will find a great flat stone at the base of the tree.
translation.kr: 나무 밑동에서 크고 평평한 바위를 하나 찾을 수 있을 것이다.

translation.en: Lift it up and bring me what lies underneath.
translation.kr: 그것을 들어 올려서 그 아래에 있는 것을 내게 가져오너라.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: Then Theseus pushed his way in through the thick bushes, and saw that they had not been moved for many a year.  And searching among their roots he found a great flat stone, all overgrown with ivy, and acanthus, and moss.  He tried to lift it, but he could not.  And he tried till the sweat ran down his brow from heat, and the tears from his eyes for shame; but all was of no avail.  And at last he came back to his mother, and said, ‘I have found the stone, but I cannot lift it; nor do I think that any man could in all Troezene.’

translation.en: Theseus pushed his way through the thick bushes.
translation.kr: 테세우스는 빽빽한 덤불을 헤치고 나아갔습니다.

translation.en: He saw they had not been touched for years.
translation.kr: 그는 그곳이 수년 동안 사람의 손길이 닿지 않았다는 것을 알았습니다.

translation.en: Among the roots, he found a great flat stone.
translation.kr: 뿌리들 사이에서 그는 크고 평평한 바위를 하나 발견했습니다.

translation.en: It was covered in ivy, moss, and leafy vines.
translation.kr: 그것은 담쟁이덩굴과 이끼, 그리고 잎이 무성한 덩굴로 덮여 있었습니다.

translation.en: He tried to lift the stone, but he failed.
translation.kr: 그는 바위를 들어 올리려 했지만 실패했습니다.

translation.en: He struggled until sweat ran down his face.
translation.kr: 그는 땀이 얼굴을 타고 흘러내릴 때까지 애를 썼습니다.

translation.en: Tears of shame filled his eyes, but it was useless.
translation.kr: 부끄러움에 눈물이 고였지만 아무 소용이 없었습니다.

translation.en: Finally, he went back to his mother.
translation.kr: 마침내 그는 어머니에게 돌아갔습니다.

translation.en: I found the stone, but I cannot lift it.
translation.kr: 바위를 찾았지만 들어 올릴 수가 없어요.

translation.en: I do not think anyone in Troezen could lift it.
translation.kr: 트로이젠의 그 누구도 그 바위를 들 수 없을 거예요.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: Then she sighed, and said, ‘The Gods wait long; but they are just at last.  Let it be for another year.  The day may come when you will be a stronger man than lives in all Troezene.’

translation.en: She sighed and spoke to him gently.
translation.kr: 그녀는 한숨을 내쉬며 다정하게 말했습니다.

translation.en: The gods wait a long time, but they are just.
translation.kr: 신들은 오래 기다리시지만 결국에는 공정하시단다.

translation.en: Let it rest for another year.
translation.kr: 일 년만 더 기다려 보자꾸나.

translation.en: You may yet become the strongest man in Troezen.
translation.kr: 네가 트로이젠에서 가장 힘센 남자가 되는 날이 올지도 모르지.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: Then she took him by the hand, and went into the temple and prayed, and came down again with Theseus to her home.

translation.en: She took him by the hand.
translation.kr: 그녀는 아들의 손을 잡았습니다.

translation.en: They went into the temple and prayed.
translation.kr: 그들은 신전으로 들어가 기도를 올렸습니다.

translation.en: Then they returned together to their home.
translation.kr: 그러고 나서 두 사람은 함께 집으로 돌아왔습니다.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: And when a full year was past she led Theseus up again to the temple, and bade him lift the stone; but he could not.

translation.en: A full year passed.
translation.kr: 일 년이라는 시간이 흘렀습니다.

translation.en: She led Theseus back up to the temple.
translation.kr: 그녀는 테세우스를 다시 신전으로 데려갔습니다.

translation.en: She told him to lift the stone, but he could not.
translation.kr: 그녀는 그에게 바위를 들어 올리라고 했지만, 그는 여전히 들 수 없었습니다.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: Then she sighed, and said the same words again, and went down, and came again the next year; but Theseus could not lift the stone then, nor the year after; and he longed to ask his mother the meaning of that stone, and what might lie underneath it; but her face was so sad that he had not the heart to ask.

translation.en: She sighed and repeated her words.
translation.kr: 그녀는 한숨을 쉬며 똑같은 말을 반복했습니다.

translation.en: They went home and returned the next year.
translation.kr: 그들은 집으로 돌아갔고 이듬해에 다시 찾아왔습니다.

translation.en: Theseus could not lift the stone that year, either.
translation.kr: 테세우스는 그해에도 바위를 들어 올리지 못했습니다.

translation.en: He failed the year after that as well.
translation.kr: 그다음 해에도 마찬가지였습니다.

translation.en: He wanted to ask his mother about the stone.
translation.kr: 그는 어머니에게 그 바위에 대해 묻고 싶었습니다.

translation.en: He wondered what lay hidden beneath it.
translation.kr: 그는 바위 아래에 무엇이 숨겨져 있는지 궁금했습니다.

translation.en: But her face looked so sad that he could not ask.
translation.kr: 하지만 어머니의 표정이 너무 슬퍼 보여서 차마 물어볼 수가 없었습니다.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: So he said to himself, ‘The day shall surely come when I will lift that stone, though no man in Troezene can.’  And in order to grow strong he spent all his days in wrestling, and boxing, and hurling, and taming horses, and hunting the boar and the bull, and coursing goats and deer among the rocks; till upon all the mountains there was no hunter so swift as Theseus; and he killed Phaia the wild sow of Crommyon, which wasted all the land; till all the people said, ‘Surely the Gods are with the lad.’

translation.en: He made a promise to himself.
translation.kr: 그는 스스로에게 다짐했습니다.

translation.en: The day will come when I lift that stone.
translation.kr: 언젠가는 내가 저 바위를 들어 올릴 날이 올 것이다.

translation.en: I will do it even if no one else can.
translation.kr: 다른 사람은 못 하더라도 나는 해낼 것이다.

translation.en: He spent his days training to grow strong.
translation.kr: 그는 힘을 기르기 위해 매일같이 훈련했습니다.

translation.en: He wrestled, boxed, and practiced throwing.
translation.kr: 그는 레슬링과 권투를 하고 던지기를 연습했습니다.

translation.en: He tamed wild horses.
translation.kr: 그는 야생마를 길들였습니다.

translation.en: He hunted boars and bulls.
translation.kr: 그는 멧돼지와 황소를 사냥했습니다.

translation.en: He chased goats and deer across the rocky hills.
translation.kr: 그는 바위투성이 언덕을 가로지르며 염소와 사슴을 뒤쫓았습니다.

translation.en: Soon, he became the swiftest hunter on the mountains.
translation.kr: 머지않아 그는 산에서 가장 날랜 사냥꾼이 되었습니다.

translation.en: He even killed a giant wild sow that ruined the land.
translation.kr: 그는 땅을 황폐하게 만든 거대한 야생 암퇘지도 죽였습니다.

translation.en: The people marveled at his strength.
translation.kr: 사람들은 그의 힘에 경탄했습니다.

translation.en: They said the gods were truly with the boy.
translation.kr: 그들은 신들께서 진정으로 저 소년과 함께하신다고 말했습니다.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: And when his eighteenth year was past, Aithra led him up again to the temple, and said, ‘Theseus, lift the stone this day, or never know who you are.’  And Theseus went into the thicket, and stood over the stone, and tugged at it; and it moved.  Then his spirit swelled within him, and he said, ‘If I break my heart in my body, it shall up.’  And he tugged at it once more, and lifted it, and rolled it over with a shout.

translation.en: When he turned eighteen, Aithra brought him back.
translation.kr: 그가 열여덟 살이 되자, 아이트라는 다시 아들을 데려왔습니다.

translation.en: She told him to lift the stone today.
translation.kr: 그녀는 오늘 그 바위를 들어 올리라고 말했습니다.

translation.en: If you fail, you will never know who you truly are.
translation.kr: 실패한다면, 네가 진정 누구인지 영원히 알 수 없을 것이다.

translation.en: Theseus went into the thicket and stood over the stone.
translation.kr: 테세우스는 덤불 속으로 들어가 바위 위로 섰습니다.

translation.en: He pulled at it, and the rock finally moved.
translation.kr: 그가 끌어당기자 마침내 바위가 움직였습니다.

translation.en: His spirit swelled with fierce pride.
translation.kr: 그의 마음속에 강렬한 자부심이 차올랐습니다.

translation.en: I will lift it even if my heart bursts.
translation.kr: 내 심장이 터지는 한이 있더라도 반드시 들어 올릴 것이다.

translation.en: He pulled once more with all his might.
translation.kr: 그는 온 힘을 다해 다시 한번 끌어당겼습니다.

translation.en: He shouted as he lifted the stone and rolled it away.
translation.kr: 그는 고함을 지르며 바위를 들어 올려 굴려 버렸습니다.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: And when he looked beneath it, on the ground lay a sword of bronze, with a hilt of glittering gold, and by it a pair of golden sandals; and he caught them up, and burst through the bushes like a wild boar, and leapt to his mother, holding them high above his head.

translation.en: He looked beneath the heavy stone.
translation.kr: 그는 무거운 바위 아래를 내려다보았습니다.

translation.en: A bronze sword lay on the ground.
translation.kr: 청동 검 한 자루가 땅에 놓여 있었습니다.

translation.en: It had a hilt made of glittering gold.
translation.kr: 그 검에는 반짝이는 황금 자루가 달려 있었습니다.

translation.en: Beside it sat a pair of golden sandals.
translation.kr: 그 옆에는 황금 샌들 한 켤레가 놓여 있었습니다.

translation.en: He quickly snatched them up.
translation.kr: 그는 재빨리 그것들을 집어 들었습니다.

translation.en: He crashed through the bushes like a wild boar.
translation.kr: 그는 거친 멧돼지처럼 덤불을 뚫고 돌진했습니다.

translation.en: He leaped toward his mother in triumph.
translation.kr: 그는 의기양양하게 어머니를 향해 뛰어갔습니다.

translation.en: He held the treasures high above his head.
translation.kr: 그는 그 보물들을 머리 위로 높이 치켜들었습니다.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: But when she saw them she wept long in silence, hiding her fair face in her shawl; and Theseus stood by her wondering, and wept also, he knew not why.  And when she was tired of weeping, she lifted up her head, and laid her finger on her lips, and said, ‘Hide them in your bosom, Theseus my son, and come with me where we can look down upon the sea.’

translation.en: When she saw the treasures, she wept in silence.
translation.kr: 보물을 보자마자 그녀는 말없이 눈물을 흘렸습니다.

translation.en: She hid her face in her shawl.
translation.kr: 그녀는 숄로 얼굴을 가렸습니다.

translation.en: Theseus stood beside her in wonder.
translation.kr: 테세우스는 놀라서 어머니 곁에 서 있었습니다.

translation.en: He began to cry, too, though he did not know why.
translation.kr: 그도 영문도 모른 채 눈물을 흘리기 시작했습니다.

translation.en: When her tears finally stopped, she raised her head.
translation.kr: 마침내 눈물이 멈추자, 그녀는 고개를 들었습니다.

translation.en: She gently placed a finger to her lips.
translation.kr: 그녀는 살며시 입술에 손가락을 얹었습니다.

translation.en: Hide them in your shirt, my son.
translation.kr: 아들아, 그것들을 옷 속에 숨기거라.

translation.en: Come with me to look down upon the sea.
translation.kr: 나와 함께 바다가 내려다보이는 곳으로 가자꾸나.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: Then they went outside the sacred wall, and looked down over the bright blue sea; and Aithra said—

translation.en: They walked past the sacred temple wall.
translation.kr: 그들은 신성한 신전의 벽을 지나 걸어갔습니다.

translation.en: They looked out over the bright blue sea.
translation.kr: 그들은 눈부시게 푸른 바다를 내다보았습니다.

translation.en: Aithra spoke to him softly.
translation.kr: 아이트라가 그에게 다정하게 말했습니다.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: ‘Do you see this land at our feet?’

translation.en: Do you see this land below us?
translation.kr: 우리 발아래에 있는 이 땅이 보이느냐?

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: And he said, ‘Yes; this is Troezene, where I was born and bred.’

translation.en: Yes, this is Troezen.
translation.kr: 네, 이곳은 트로이젠입니다.

translation.en: It is the place where I was born and raised.
translation.kr: 제가 태어나고 자란 곳이지요.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: And she said, ‘It is but a little land, barren and rocky, and looks towards the bleak north-east.  Do you see that land beyond?’

translation.en: It is only a small, rocky land.
translation.kr: 그곳은 단지 작고 바위가 많은 땅일 뿐이란다.

translation.en: It faces the cold, bleak northeast.
translation.kr: 차갑고 황량한 북동쪽을 향하고 있지.

translation.en: Do you see that land far beyond the water?
translation.kr: 바다 너머 저 멀리 있는 땅이 보이느냐?

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: ‘Yes; that is Attica, where the Athenian people dwell.’

translation.en: Yes, that is Attica.
translation.kr: 네, 저곳은 아티카입니다.

translation.en: That is where the Athenian people live.
translation.kr: 아테네 사람들이 살고 있는 곳이지요.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: [Picture: Theseus and Aithra]

translation.en: [Picture: Theseus and Aithra]
translation.kr: [그림: 테세우스와 아이트라]

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: ‘That is a fair land and large, Theseus my son; and it looks toward the sunny south; a land of olive-oil and honey, the joy of Gods and men.  For the Gods have girdled it with mountains, whose veins are of pure silver, and their bones of marble white as snow; and there the hills are sweet with thyme and basil, and the meadows with violet and asphodel, and the nightingales sing all day in the thickets, by the side of ever-flowing streams.  There are twelve towns well peopled, the homes of an ancient race, the children of Kekrops the serpent king, the son of Mother Earth, who wear gold cicalas among the tresses of their golden hair; for like the cicalas they sprang from the earth, and like the cicalas they sing all day, rejoicing in the genial sun.  What would you do, son Theseus, if you were king of such a land?’

translation.en: That is a vast and beautiful land, my son.
translation.kr: 아들아, 저곳은 넓고 아름다운 땅이란다.

translation.en: It faces the warm, sunny south.
translation.kr: 따뜻하고 햇살이 가득한 남쪽을 향하고 있지.

translation.en: It is a land of olive oil and sweet honey.
translation.kr: 올리브 오일과 달콤한 꿀이 흐르는 곳이란다.

translation.en: It brings joy to both gods and men.
translation.kr: 신들과 인간 모두에게 기쁨을 주는 곳이지.

translation.en: The gods surrounded it with great mountains.
translation.kr: 신들께서 그곳을 거대한 산맥으로 둘러싸셨단다.

translation.en: The mountains hide veins of pure silver.
translation.kr: 그 산들에는 순은 광맥이 숨겨져 있어.

translation.en: Their rocky bones are made of snow-white marble.
translation.kr: 그 바위뼈는 눈처럼 하얀 대리석으로 이루어져 있지.

translation.en: The hills smell sweet with fresh herbs.
translation.kr: 언덕에서는 신선한 허브의 달콤한 향기가 난단다.

translation.en: The meadows bloom with bright wild flowers.
translation.kr: 초원에는 화사한 야생화들이 만발해 있어.

translation.en: Nightingales sing all day in the thickets.
translation.kr: 덤불 속에서는 종일 나이팅게일이 노래한단다.

translation.en: Clear streams flow beside the singing birds.
translation.kr: 노래하는 새들 곁으로 맑은 시냇물이 흐르지.

translation.en: There are twelve towns filled with people.
translation.kr: 사람들로 북적이는 열두 개의 마을이 있단다.

translation.en: They are the ancient children of the serpent king.
translation.kr: 그들은 뱀의 왕의 오래된 후손들이야.

translation.en: They wear golden ornaments in their hair.
translation.kr: 그들은 머리에 황금 장식을 달고 다닌단다.

translation.en: Like nature's creatures, they sprang from the earth.
translation.kr: 대자연의 피조물처럼 그들도 땅에서 솟아났지.

translation.en: They sing in the warm sun all day long.
translation.kr: 그들은 따뜻한 햇살을 받으며 하루 종일 노래한단다.

translation.en: What would you do if you ruled such a land?
translation.kr: 네가 그런 땅을 다스리는 왕이라면 어떻게 하겠느냐?

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: Then Theseus stood astonished, as he looked across the broad bright sea, and saw the fair Attic shore, from Sunium to Hymettus and Pentelicus, and all the mountain peaks which girdle Athens round.  But Athens itself he could not see, for purple Ægina stood before it, midway across the sea.

translation.en: Theseus stood completely astonished.
translation.kr: 테세우스는 몹시 놀라 그 자리에 멈춰 섰습니다.

translation.en: He looked across the bright, wide sea.
translation.kr: 그는 눈부시고 넓은 바다를 가로질러 바라보았습니다.

translation.en: He saw the beautiful shores of Attica.
translation.kr: 그는 아티카의 아름다운 해안을 보았습니다.

translation.en: He saw the great mountain peaks surrounding Athens.
translation.kr: 그는 아테네를 둘러싼 거대한 산봉우리들을 보았습니다.

translation.en: But he could not see the city of Athens itself.
translation.kr: 하지만 아테네 시 자체는 볼 수 없었습니다.

translation.en: The purple island of Aegina blocked his view.
translation.kr: 자줏빛 아이기나 섬이 그의 시야를 가로막고 있었기 때문입니다.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: Then his heart grew great within him, and he said, ‘If I were king of such a land I would rule it wisely and well in wisdom and in might, that when I died all men might weep over my tomb, and cry, “Alas for the shepherd of his people!”’

translation.en: His heart swelled with great ambition.
translation.kr: 그의 마음속에 원대한 야망이 차올랐습니다.

translation.en: If I were king of such a land, I would rule it well.
translation.kr: 제가 그런 땅의 왕이라면 나라를 훌륭하게 다스리겠습니다.

translation.en: I would rule with deep wisdom and strong might.
translation.kr: 저는 깊은 지혜와 강한 힘으로 통치할 것입니다.

translation.en: When I die, all people would weep over my tomb.
translation.kr: 제가 죽을 때 모든 백성이 제 무덤에서 눈물을 흘리게 만들겠습니다.

translation.en: They would cry for the lost shepherd of their people.
translation.kr: 그들은 백성의 목자를 잃었다며 슬퍼할 것입니다.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: And Aithra smiled, and said, ‘Take, then, the sword and the sandals, and go to Ægeus, king of Athens, who lives on Pallas’ hill; and say to him, “The stone is lifted, but whose is the pledge beneath it?”  Then show him the sword and the sandals, and take what the Gods shall send.’

translation.en: Aithra smiled at her son's brave words.
translation.kr: 아이트라는 아들의 용감한 말에 미소를 지었습니다.

translation.en: Take the sword and the sandals, then.
translation.kr: 그렇다면 그 검과 샌들을 챙기거라.

translation.en: Go to Aegeus, the king of Athens.
translation.kr: 아테네의 왕 아이게우스에게로 가거라.

translation.en: Tell him the stone has been lifted.
translation.kr: 그에게 바위가 들어 올려졌다고 전하거라.

translation.en: Ask him who owns the pledge hidden beneath it.
translation.kr: 그 아래 숨겨진 증표의 주인이 누구인지 물어보아라.

translation.en: Show him the sword and the sandals.
translation.kr: 그에게 검과 샌들을 보여 주거라.

translation.en: Then accept whatever fate the gods send you.
translation.kr: 그러고 나서 신들께서 네게 내리시는 운명을 받아들이거라.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: But Theseus wept, ‘Shall I leave you, O my mother?’

translation.en: Theseus wept at the thought of leaving.
translation.kr: 테세우스는 떠난다는 생각에 눈물을 흘렸습니다.

translation.en: Must I really leave you, my mother?
translation.kr: 어머니, 제가 정말 어머니 곁을 떠나야만 합니까?

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: But she answered, ‘Weep not for me.  That which is fated must be; and grief is easy to those who do nought but grieve.  Full of sorrow was my youth, and full of sorrow my womanhood.  Full of sorrow was my youth for Bellerophon, the slayer of the Chimæra, whom my father drove away by treason; and full of sorrow my womanhood, for thy treacherous father and for thee; and full of sorrow my old age will be (for I see my fate in dreams), when the sons of the Swan shall carry me captive to the hollow vale of Eurotas, till I sail across the seas a slave, the handmaid of the pest of Greece.  Yet shall I be avenged, when the golden-haired heroes sail against Troy, and sack the palaces of Ilium; then my son shall set me free from thraldom, and I shall hear the tale of Theseus’ fame.  Yet beyond that I see new sorrows; but I can bear them as I have borne the past.’

translation.en: She answered, Do not weep for me.
translation.kr: 그녀가 대답했습니다. 나를 위해 울지 말아라.

translation.en: What is fated must come to pass.
translation.kr: 운명 지어진 일은 반드시 일어나기 마련이란다.

translation.en: My youth was filled with deep sorrow.
translation.kr: 나의 젊은 시절은 깊은 슬픔으로 가득했지.

translation.en: My womanhood has also been full of tears.
translation.kr: 나의 여인으로서의 삶 또한 눈물로 얼룩졌단다.

translation.en: I mourned for the great hero who slayed the Chimera.
translation.kr: 나는 키메라를 죽인 위대한 영웅을 위해 슬퍼했지.

translation.en: My father drove him away with cruel treason.
translation.kr: 나의 아버지가 잔인한 반역으로 그를 쫓아냈기 때문이야.

translation.en: I mourned for your treacherous father, and for you.
translation.kr: 나는 믿을 수 없는 너의 아버지와 너를 생각하며 슬퍼했단다.

translation.en: My old age will be just as sorrowful.
translation.kr: 나의 노년 또한 그만큼 슬플 것이야.

translation.en: I have seen my dark fate in my dreams.
translation.kr: 나는 꿈속에서 나의 어두운 운명을 보았단다.

translation.en: Fierce warriors will carry me away as a captive.
translation.kr: 사나운 전사들이 나를 포로로 끌고 갈 것이다.

translation.en: They will take me to a distant, hollow valley.
translation.kr: 그들은 나를 멀고 텅 빈 계곡으로 데려갈 테지.

translation.en: I will sail across the seas as a helpless slave.
translation.kr: 나는 힘없는 노예가 되어 바다를 건너게 될 것이다.

translation.en: But I know that I shall finally be avenged.
translation.kr: 하지만 마침내 복수가 이루어지리라는 것을 나는 안단다.

translation.en: Golden-haired heroes will sail against the city of Troy.
translation.kr: 금발의 영웅들이 트로이 성을 향해 항해할 것이다.

translation.en: They will sack the great palaces of Ilium.
translation.kr: 그들은 일리움의 거대한 궁전들을 짓밟을 것이다.

translation.en: Then my son will set me free from my chains.
translation.kr: 그때 내 아들이 나를 사슬에서 풀어줄 것이야.

translation.en: I will finally hear the grand tale of your fame.
translation.kr: 마침내 나는 네 명성에 대한 장대한 이야기를 듣게 될 것이다.

translation.en: I see new sorrows beyond even that day.
translation.kr: 나는 그날 너머에 있는 새로운 슬픔들도 본단다.

translation.en: But I can bear them, just as I have borne the past.
translation.kr: 하지만 내가 과거를 견뎌왔듯이, 그 모든 것도 견뎌낼 수 있단다.

part: Part I: How Theseus Lifted the Stone
raw: Then she kissed Theseus, and wept over him; and went into the temple, and Theseus saw her no more.

translation.en: She kissed Theseus and wept over him.
translation.kr: 그녀는 테세우스에게 입을 맞추고 그를 위해 눈물을 흘렸습니다.

translation.en: Then she turned and went into the temple.
translation.kr: 그러고 나서 그녀는 돌아서서 신전으로 들어갔습니다.

translation.en: Theseus saw her no more.
translation.kr: 테세우스는 그 후로 그녀를 볼 수 없었습니다.
